name: Zechariah
role: Priest, father of John the Baptist
whenBasis: In the days of Herod king of Judea (Luke 1:5), whose death is reckoned to 4 BC or to 1 BC; John was born about six months before Jesus (Luke 1:36). See the card on dating Herod's death.
summary: A priest of the division of Abijah, husband of Elizabeth. While he burned incense in the temple, the angel Gabriel told him his prayer was heard: Elizabeth would bear a son, to be named John, who would go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah. Because he asked, “How can I be sure of this?”, he was struck silent until the child was born. When he wrote, “His name is John,” his tongue was freed and he prophesied the Benedictus.
body: The people outside wonder why he stays so long in the sanctuary, and realise he has seen a vision when he comes out unable to speak. His song blesses the God of Israel for visiting his people and tells his son, “And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High.”

moments.text: “How can I be sure of this?”

later.text: The division of Abijah was the eighth of the twenty-four priestly courses David set up.
The Protevangelium of James says Herod had him killed in the temple for not revealing where John was hidden.
